card.name: Packaging and container handling words
card.fires_on: Words about opening, labeling or marking a package, such as opening, on (before the package or container), opened, closure and front (before label). Also manufacturer's before instructions.

modes.label: Opening the package
modes.description: The word opening or opened when describing how to open a pouch or bottle.
modes.example: Instructions for<< opening>> the pouch containing GLIADEL Wafer

modes.label: Printed on the package
modes.description: The word on after stated, indicated or given, just before the package, container or packaging.
modes.example: unopened vials of cladribine injection are stable until the expiration date indicated<< on>> the package.

modes.label: Label and closure parts
modes.description: Words naming parts of the container or label, or the manufacturer's instructions for use.
modes.example: Attach administration set per manufacturer<<'s>> instructions.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that continue a package or label phrase, and away from words like accompanying or included.
card.plain: It fires on words about opening a package or what is printed on its label or container.
